title: 有限主权与控制税：当部署者不拥有模型时为AI监管定价
summary: 本文提出“有限主权”概念，指部署者仅部分控制AI栈的数据、模型、基础设施和交互层。通过四层访问类型学、协议-层需求矩阵和主权折扣成本，分析访问条件如何决定控制协议可行性。基于135万合成案例的消融实验显示，完整日志、执行前网关、追踪访问和范围限制可提升安全性，但控制协议需明确访问假设。
summary_en: This paper introduces bounded sovereignty—partial access across AI stack layers—and a sovereignty discount cost to price AI oversight when deployers lack model ownership. A four-layer typology and protocol matrix show access conditions determine control protocol feasibility. Synthetic ablation over 1.35M cases finds logs, gateways, and scope restriction improve safety, urging explicit access assumptions.
